title: 第21章 意外第22章 蜥蜴博士
content_zh:
第21章意外
格温的话让吸血鬼一愣，随即怒声骂道：“胡说八道，人类只是我们血族的食物……”
砰，安德鲁用雨伞将吸血鬼砸晕过去，他说道：“看来，变成吸血鬼会降智商。”
凯斯有点不解地问道：“吸血鬼如果真那么容易消灭，为什么人类高层一直不动手？”
“或许是因为人类高层想要长生。”
安德鲁说道：“好了，你们可以离开了，刚刚看到的，不要说出去，否则会给自己惹麻烦。”
一个人义愤填膺地说道：“我要向全世界揭示真相，让所有人知道，高层一直在欺骗我们。”
“没用，因为不会有人相信你。”
安德鲁摇头：“另外，吸血鬼行事这么张扬，现实里却一点消息都没有，你们不觉得奇怪吗？离开吧，就当找了一场刺激，做了一个噩梦。”
凯斯他们一愣，随即沮丧的选择离开，他们只是普通大学生，没有勇气搀和这样的事。
格温却留了下来，她有点不好意思的问道：“安德鲁，我能抽一管吸血鬼的鲜血吗？”
安德鲁问道：“你想要吸血鬼的血？”
格温说道：“对，我想研究一下，我学的是生物专业，在奥斯本集团实习。”
安德鲁无所谓的说道：“那就抽吧，小心一点。”
“谢谢。”
格温一喜，从包里翻出一把小刀和一个小瓶子，接着，她先用酒精给瓶子和小刀消毒，然后小心翼翼的切开吸血鬼的皮肤，将鲜血弄到瓶子里。
格温是生物专业，解剖过许多生物，这点事，难不倒她。
取完血后，格温将东西小心收好，接着，她有些羞涩的朝安德鲁问道：“安德鲁，你能不能把手机号码给我？”
没等安德鲁回答，格温急促的解释道：“我只是想好好谢谢你，没有你，我这一次肯定要遭殃。”
安德鲁笑了笑，说道：“谁能拒绝我们的格温小姐？你不介意的话，我送你回家。”

“好啊，呃，我暂时不回家，我要回一趟奥斯本集团，将吸血鬼的血液处理下。”
格温开心的答应，接着，安德鲁带着格温离开仓库，他走后，地上的吸血鬼消失不见，却是进入重生地狱——特斯拉克想研究一下，看看能不能用吸血鬼基因对付x基因。
特斯拉克上辈子加这辈子只有一个梦想，那就是消灭变种人。
停车场，格温见到安德鲁的哈雷摩托，眼睛发亮地说道：“哇，好酷的摩托。”
“摩托车可是我们男人的浪漫。”
安德鲁将头盔递给格温，格温戴上，接着，她坐到摩托上，有些脸红心跳的抱住安德鲁的腰。
安德鲁微微一笑，载着格温小姐如离弦的利箭一般冲了出去。
一个小时后，摩托车来到奥斯本集团楼下，格温有些恋恋不舍的下车，她将头盔还给安德鲁，说道：“那我们明天见。”
“嗯。”
安德鲁点了点头，目送格温进入大厦，同时悄悄送了她一个魔法印记。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Accident
Gwen's words stunned the vampire, and then he cursed angrily: "Nonsense, humans are just food for our vampires..."
Bang, Andrew knocked the vampire unconscious with his umbrella and said, "It seems that becoming a vampire will lower your IQ."
Keith asked a little puzzled: "If vampires are so easy to eliminate, why haven't the higher-ups in the human race taken action?"
"Perhaps it's because the top human beings want to live forever."
Andrew said: "Okay, you can leave. Don't tell anyone about what you just saw, otherwise you will get yourself into trouble."
One person said with righteous indignation: "I want to reveal the truth to the world and let everyone know that the top brass has been lying to us."
"It's useless because no one will believe you."
Andrew shook his head: "Besides, don't you find it strange that vampires act so openly, but there is no news at all in reality? Leave, just think of it as a thrill and a nightmare."
Keith and the others were stunned for a moment, and then chose to leave in frustration. They were just ordinary college students and did not have the courage to interfere in such a thing.
Gwen stayed, and she asked a little embarrassedly: "Andrew, can I draw a tube of vampire blood?"
Andrew asked, "You want vampire blood?"
Gwen said: "Yes, I want to study it. I major in biology and am interning at Osborne Group."
Andrew said nonchalantly: "Then smoke, be careful."
"Thank you."
Gwen was overjoyed and took out a knife and a small bottle from her bag. Then, she sterilized the bottle and the knife with alcohol, then carefully cut open the vampire's skin and got the blood into the bottle.
Gwen majored in biology and had dissected many living things. This matter was not difficult for her.
After taking the blood, Gwen carefully put away the things. Then, she shyly asked Andrew: "Andrew, can you give me your mobile phone number?"
Before Andrew could answer, Gwen explained hurriedly: "I just want to thank you properly. Without you, I will definitely suffer this time."
Andrew smiled and said, "Who can refuse our Miss Gwen? If you don't mind, I will take you home."
"Okay, uh, I won't go home for the time being. I want to go back to the Osborne Group to process the vampire's blood."
Gwen happily agreed, and then, Andrew took Gwen out of the warehouse. After he left, the vampires on the ground disappeared, but they entered the hell of rebirth - Teslak wanted to study it to see if vampire genes could be used to deal with the X-gene.
Teslak had only one dream in his previous life and this life, and that was to eliminate mutants.
In the parking lot, Gwen saw Andrew's Harley-Davidson motorcycle and said with bright eyes: "Wow, what a cool motorcycle."
"Motorcycles are our men's romance."
Andrew handed the helmet to Gwen, and Gwen put it on. Then, she sat on the motorcycle, blushing and hugging Andrew's waist.
Andrew smiled slightly and rushed out with Miss Gwen like a sharp arrow from a string.
An hour later, the motorcycle arrived downstairs at the Osborne Group. Gwen got off the motorcycle reluctantly. She returned the helmet to Andrew and said, "Then we'll see you tomorrow."
"Yeah."
Andrew nodded and watched Gwen enter the building, while quietly giving her a magic mark.
